body.text: Executives, founders, diplomats, and public figures often postpone care abroad because they do not want to cross crowded hotel lobbies in surgical dressings or share sensitive files across commission-based WhatsApp brokers. At [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/about), our two founders work exclusively on a client-paid, flat-fee basis—paid by our clients and independent of provider commissions—so your itinerary is built for low visibility from runway to discharge. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions.
How do private hospital wings and VIP airport Fast Track protect discretion?

Major accredited hospitals in Istanbul offer dedicated VIP inpatient floors with private elevator access, sound-insulated suites, and in-room administrative registration so you avoid shared waiting rooms. At Istanbul Airport (IST), pre-booking [iGA Fast Track](https://www.igapass.com/en/iga-fast-track-p-4000) and [iGA Meet & Greet](https://www.igapass.com/en/iga-meet-and-greet-p-7000) pairs you with a personal escort, private buggy transport, priority passport lanes, and quiet lounge access away from main concourses.

For travellers arriving with bandages, swelling, or compression garments, minimizing time in public queues matters as much for physical comfort as for anonymity. Escorts meet you directly at the aircraft bridge on arrival and guide you straight to your waiting chauffeur outside the terminal, cutting exposure time to minutes.
How does ITO handle confidentiality and KVKK data protection?

Türkiye's [Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK)](https://www.kvkk.gov.tr/Icerik/6649/Personal-Data-Protection-Law) classifies health data as special-category personal data subject to strict legal safeguards, as outlined in the [KVKK Purpose and Scope guide](https://www.kvkk.gov.tr/Icerik/7456/Purpose-and-Scope-of-The-Personal-Data-Protection-Law-No-6698). Itinerary of Türkiye minimizes data exposure by never requesting clinical records, diagnostic scans, or surgical photos—those stay strictly between you and your chosen licensed hospital.
Because we do not act as a clinic broker, your personal details are never circulated to multiple competing clinics for quotes. Our confidentiality workflow follows four strict rules:

items: Zero clinical file collection: Medical histories and lab results go directly to your medical provider's encrypted patient portal, never to our inbox.
Need-to-know vendor briefing: Drivers and hotel concierges receive timing, access instructions, and room requirements without any mention of your procedure type.
No social media or testimonial use: We never photograph clients, publish case studies, or ask for public reviews tied to your identity.
Single-point founder communication: You communicate directly with our two founders rather than a rotating call center.

body.text: Which quiet Bosphorus or hillside hotels offer maximum privacy during recovery?

During recovery, low-density waterfront and hillside properties beat busy Sultanahmet or Taksim tourist corridors because they offer spacious suites, 24-hour in-room dining, discreet side entrances, and calm Bosphorus views. Properties well suited to private recovery include [Mandarin Oriental Bosphorus, Istanbul](https://www.mandarinoriental.com/en/istanbul/bosphorus), [Four Seasons Hotel Istanbul at the Bosphorus](https://www.fourseasons.com/bosphorus/), [Çırağan Palace Kempinski Istanbul](https://www.kempinski.com/en/ciragan-palace), [Raffles Istanbul](https://www.raffles.com/istanbul/), and [Kocataş Mansions, İstanbul](https://guide.michelin.com/en/hotels-stays/istanbul/six-senses-kocatas-mansions-11174).

body.text: We arrange in-suite check-in where available, request quiet high-floor or garden-facing rooms away from elevators, and coordinate dietary room-service preferences ahead of arrival through our [medical tourism coordination service](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/services/medical-tourism).
How do private drivers coordinate direct garage-to-clinic arrivals?

Rather than dropping you at a busy main boulevard entrance, experienced private chauffeurs pre-coordinate with hotel security and hospital VIP desks to use underground parking bays and private service elevators. Vehicles feature privacy-tinted rear glass, smooth touring suspension, and pre-cleared license plates so gates open immediately on arrival.

Before each follow-up appointment, our team confirms the exact arrival bay, elevator code, and escort handoff time. If you prefer a companion or private nurse arranged through your hospital to travel with you, we size the vehicle accordingly so every transfer between hotel and clinic stays calm and unhurried.

If you need discreet, flat-fee logistics in Istanbul without broker markups or unnecessary data sharing, contact us through our [medical tourism coordination page](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/services/medical-tourism) or read about our founders on our [About page](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/about). Please do not send passport or ID scans, medical records, or payment details in your first enquiry—share only your general travel window and privacy requirements so we can outline next steps.

faq.q: Can I register at an Istanbul hotel under an alias?
faq.a: Turkish law requires hotels to register every guest's legal passport identity with local authorities at check-in. However, luxury hotels can place your folio on strict "incognito" or "do not disclose" status so staff never confirm your stay to callers or visitors.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA)?
faq.a: Yes. For clients who require formal contractual confidentiality for travel and logistical coordination, our founders can execute a mutual NDA before detailed itinerary planning begins.

faq.q: Can private airport transfers bypass Istanbul traffic?
faq.a: No vehicle can legally bypass public highway traffic without official state escort, but timing transfers outside peak rush hours—or using private Bosphorus water taxis from waterfront hotel piers when medically appropriate—significantly reduces transit friction.

faq.q: Will my chauffeur know what medical procedure I am having?
faq.a: No. Drivers receive pickup times, hospital bay instructions, and smooth-driving guidelines, never clinical details about your surgery or diagnosis.

faq.q: Can I use a private jet terminal at Istanbul Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Istanbul Airport operates a dedicated General Aviation Terminal for private charter arrivals and departures with private customs and direct tarmac-to-vehicle transfers, which we can coordinate alongside your ground transport.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye recommend specific "VIP partner" clinics?
faq.a: No. We accept no commissions or referral fees from any hospital or surgeon. You choose your licensed medical team independently, and we handle all travel, privacy, and recovery logistics.
